subject: [PATCH 0/3] zstd: probe the CPU for BMI2 support once, not per context

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch series optimizes the Zstandard (zstd) compression library in the Linux kernel by reducing unnecessary CPUID probes for BMI2 support. The current implementation probes for BMI2 support every time a compression or decompression context is set up, which can lead to performance issues due to serializing CPUID instructions on x86. This patch series introduces caching and dynamic dispatching of BMI2 support, resulting in significant performance improvements (up to 71% reduction in decompression time) by reducing the number of CPUID probes.
